html:
Question 9
?

Which of the following describes the level surfaces of the function f(x,y,z)=3zx+6y?

a
A family of planes: z=c3x+c2y
b
A family of planes: z=c3x+2cy
c
A family of surfaces: z=3cx+6y
d
A family of planes: z=3cx+c2y
e
A family of surfaces: z=c3(x+6y)
